name: StaticMesh
description: A StaticMesh entity represents a Mesh which can be spawned in the world, can't move and is more optimized for using in decorating the world.

parameters.name: static_mesh_asset
parameters.description: The Static Mesh asset to use

parameters.name: spawn_mode
parameters.description: Pass SpawnMode.AfterConstructor or SpawnMode.Manual to avoid immediately sending the entity to clients and improve performance when you want to configure it by setting several configs. Must call FinishSpawn() after all

functions.name: GetMesh
functions.description: Gets the Asset path mesh used

functions.name: IsFromLevel
functions.description: Gets if this StaticMesh is from the Level

return.description: if this StaticMesh is from the level
return.name: is_from_level
